prompt: Bounded static/mock Relay safety task only. Consolidate payload override validation so Dispatcher and DispatchEnvelope use the same fail-closed rule. Today RelayDispatcher locally rejects top-level payload keys that could override runtime/provider/safety configuration, but DispatchEnvelope.build does not, so RelayLifecycle callers can construct and prompt a mock envelope containing those forbidden override keys. Define one shared validator in src/relay/envelope.py, e.g. validate_payload(payload), and make both DispatchEnvelope.build and RelayDispatcher.dispatch call it rather than duplicating the blocked-key set. Require payload to be a dict; reject non-dict payloads before reservation/hash/dispatch. Preserve the current forbidden top-level key set exactly: model, modelProvider, serviceTier, reasoning, effort, thinking, approvalPolicy, approvalsReviewer, sandbox, sandboxPolicy, cwd, config, base, developer, general instructions, plugin disabling, billing, auth route, timeout_seconds. Do not recursively reject ordinary user content strings that merely contain these words; this is only top-level key validation. Keep canonical hashing unchanged for valid payloads. Add focused tests proving each forbidden key is rejected by DispatchEnvelope.build and RelayDispatcher before reservation/provider dispatch; non-dict payloads rejected by both paths; ordinary nested/user-content text containing those words remains accepted; valid payload snapshot/hash/determinism and existing timeout/provider/preflight behavior unchanged. No new files. Preserve retry=0, fallback disabled, provider isolation, no-live markers and all current lifecycle semantics. No provider/network/auth/API/billing/settings/persistence changes. Run PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v, python -m compileall -q src tests, git diff --check.
